notes.title: Important Announcement
notes.notes:
Important Announcement:

Dear players,

We are here to share an important update with all of you. After careful consideration and in our ongoing efforts to deliver a better gaming experience, we have made the decision to transition our free game into a paid game.

This decision was not made lightly, but we believe it will contribute to the long-term development of the game and provide higher-quality content. By introducing a paid model, we will be able to continue updating and improving the game, as well as offer more exciting features and events.

We understand that this decision may disappoint some players, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. We are immensely grateful for your support and engagement during the free period. We will do our best to ensure a smooth transition and provide players with additional paid content and value.

For those who have already invested time and money during the free game period, we will offer special discounts and rewards as a token of appreciation for your continuous support.

The transition will gradually take place over the next few weeks. We will release more information and details on the Steam platform, allowing players to stay informed and make necessary arrangements.

Once again, we extend our heartfelt thanks for your support and understanding. We look forward to presenting you with an even more exciting gaming world.

Warmest regards
